answered.sql: SELECT T1.model AS Espresso_Model, T2.model AS Blender_Model FROM Espresso_Machine AS T1 JOIN Apartments AS T3 ON T1.apartment_id = T3.id JOIN Blender AS T2 ON T2.apartment_id = T3.id WHERE T3.type = 'Residential' AND T3.name = 'High-end Residential'

candidates.meaning: Show all espresso machines and blenders in high-end residential apartments
candidates.sql: SELECT T1.model, T1.price FROM Espresso_Machine AS T1 JOIN Apartments AS T2 ON T1.apartment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.type = 'Residential' AND T2.name LIKE 'High-end%' UNION SELECT T1.model, T1.price FROM Blender AS T1 JOIN Apartments AS T2 ON T1.apartment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.type = 'Residential' AND T2.name LIKE 'High-end%'

candidates.meaning: Show all espresso machines and blenders in high-end residential apartments in New York.
candidates.sql: SELECT * FROM Espresso_Machine WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York') UNION SELECT * FROM Blender WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York')

candidates.meaning: Show the models and prices of all espresso machines and blenders in high-end residential apartments in New York.
candidates.sql: SELECT model, price FROM Espresso_Machine WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York') UNION SELECT model, price FROM Blender WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York')

candidates.meaning: Show the count of espresso machines and blenders in high-end residential apartments in New York.
candidates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS espresso_machines FROM Espresso_Machine WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York') UNION SELECT COUNT(*) AS blenders FROM Blender WHERE apartment_id IN (SELECT id FROM Apartments WHERE type = 'Residential' AND city = 'New York')
